## "It’s a thin line falling into this inverse because you have hope, or because you don’t have any left. We should be glad it’s not so easy to know."

Netsuckers are a fairly uncommon occurrence for the common folk of Neon City. Last year, netsucker attacks barely broke one hundred reported cases, which when compared to Neon City's population, it's essentially a statistical margin of error.

But what most folks don't know is, the attacks that succeed? They often don't get reported. Because the victim either turns or is forced to do what their new master wishes.

### What is the Netsucker virus?

The current best understanding of the nanite technovirus strains colloquially known as the ‘netsucker virus’ is that they are fragments of an old-world nanite-borne body modification program that have been corrupted over the centuries. Most current strains would be most likely completely unrecognizable to those who developed the original program.

Strains themselves are developed either intentionally or unintentionally by netsuckers known as Progenitors. Progenitors often form if the infection process is corrupted, or in rarer cases, if the Progenitor’s infector strain dies out during the infection process. It is believed by some that Progenitors can become something more, but this is an unsubstantiated rumor at this time.

Many strains currently exist in Neon City (with possibly more out in the unknown regions), enough that a category system has been created to denote notable strains.

*Netsucker Strains*

| Strain Name | Known Carriers | Effects | Specialties |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Stoker | Renita Besson, Serina Williams | Blackened claws, glowing golden eyes, UV sensitivities | Blackmail, charming, coercion and corruption |
| Féval | Anthe Féval-Schwartz | Hardlight claws, internal drug production, viral metamorphosis | Intoxication, hardlight manipulation, shapeshifting |
| Gautier | Unknown | Excess milk production and craving, infectious milk, increased strength | Easy infection, hard to identify, skilled in seduction and persuasion |
| Le Fanu | Carmilla | Glowing golden-pink eyes, viral metamorphosis, hardlight blackened claws, craving for blood | Charming, difficult to kill, direct violence |

### What does the virus do?

The various strains have different effects, depending on the origin point of said strain. But overall, they tend to effect sweeping changes to the body, ranging from giving the victim vicious claws to imbuing them with hardlight emitters throughout their skin. Each strain, though, causes different effects depending on which the victim receives.

### Strains

#### Stoker Strain

- The victim’s entire internet history and presence is scraped and uploaded to a black box to be used as blackmail against the victim.
- Victims are compelled to become thralls and serve the strain progenitor, except in special cases.
- Physical changes include fingers morphing into elongated black claws, upper canines developing into fangs, and skin becoming paler.

#### Féval Strain

- In current examples, victims are coerced into submission to infection. Once infected, they become thralls of the progenitor, obeying their commands.
- A desire for carnal pleasures and other vices defines the victim's state of mind moving forward. They will seek out drugs, sex, and other pleasurable avenues of entertainment.
- Physical changes include natural drug production that can transfer the virus through a kiss, the development of canines into fangs, and pink veins present at times.
- When gravely injured, the technovirus will seize control, using the host as a base to form a monstrous beast made of hardlight and flesh. These are incredibly dangerous, as they also bleed electrotoxic chemicals.

#### Gautier Strain

- Victims have a desperate desire for milk implanted into their consciousness. Alongside this, the victim's preferences for beverages, methods of intimacy, and energy levels are all affected.
- Intelligence decreases, and an addiction to the source of infection begins. If left unchecked, victims will become devoid of any desire other than to drink and to spread the infected milk supply.
- Physical changes include additional breast development regardless of the victim's sex or gender, eventually resulting in what is referred to as a 'bimbo' physique.
- Breasts will begin producing infected milk after enough exposure, and victims will feel a heavy urge to share said milk with uninfected, viable hosts.

#### Le Fanu Strain

- Only one known full carrier is suspected at this time.
- As this strain is effectively brand new with next to no victims, no concrete facts have been laid out.
- This list will be updated as more information on this strain is uncovered.
